Plugin.Name: SMB Bulk Share Control
Plugin.Overview: Adds a Settings -> User Utilities -> SMB Bulk Share Control page for enabling or disabling SMB export across user shares in bulk. Preserves each share's security mode and existing hidden/Time Machine export modes, excludes appdata/domains/system/isos by default, creates a timestamped backup before every change with restore support, and offers an optional automatic mode that keeps new or disabled shares exported.
